options.content:
### Access the Cluster SLO Dashboard

Monitors credential operation health (requestcredential, revokecredentials) against defined SLOs.

**SLO Targets (Proposed — pending baseline):**
- Credential operation success rate: 95% over 7-day rolling window
- Stuck operations: none > 1 hour

**Metrics Source:** `backend_resource_operation_phase_info`, `backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds` (Cosmos DB-backed)

**Jira:** [ARO-26191](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ARO-26191) | **Runbook:** [Access the Cluster](https://aka.ms/arohcp-runbook-access-cluster)

panels.description: Current credential operation success rate — fraction of terminal operations in succeeded state. SLO target: 95%.

targets.expr:
(
  (count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters", operation_type=~"requestcredential|revokecredentials", phase="succeeded"}) or vector(0))
  /
  (count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters", operation_type=~"requestcredential|revokecredentials", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) > 0 or vector(1))
) * 100

panels.title: Credential Operation Success Rate

panels.description: Current count of credential operations in failed terminal state.
panels.title: Failed Credential Operations

panels.description: Number of credential operations stuck in non-terminal phase for over 1 hour.
panels.title: Stuck Credential Ops (>1h)

panels.description: Total credential operations tracked by the backend.
panels.title: Total Credential Operations

panels.description: Credential operation success rate over time. The green line marks the 95% SLO target.

targets.expr:
(
  (count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters", operation_type=~"requestcredential|revokecredentials", phase="succeeded"}) or vector(0))
  /
  (count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters", operation_type=~"requestcredential|revokecredentials", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) > 0 or vector(1))
) * 100

panels.title: Credential Operation Phase Distribution

panels.description: Duration of in-flight credential operations (time since start for operations in non-terminal phases).

panels.description: Duration of completed credential operations (succeeded and failed).
panels.title: Completed Credential Operation Duration

panels.description: Frontend request rate for credential endpoints (requestAdminCredential, revokeCredentials).
panels.title: Frontend Credential Request Rate (Traffic)

panels.title: Credential Operations by Type and Outcome

panels.description: Credential controller workqueue depth. Alert threshold: > 10 for 5 minutes.

panels.description: Ratio of retries to total adds for credential controllers. Alert threshold: > 50% for 10 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (name, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(workqueue_retries_total{namespace="aro-hcp", name=~".*(RequestCredential|RevokeCredentials).*"}[10m]))) / sum by (name, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(workqueue_adds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", name=~".*(RequestCredential|RevokeCredentials).*"}[10m])))
